item.tib: spyi spungs gab pa gsung chen khro bo lha rgod thog pa'i rgyud las rgyal mo'i thugs kyi gzer bu dbal mo'i srog gi theg le
item.coloph: da lta ma 'ong gi dus su/ sde brgyad 'dul ba'i dbal bon khro bo lha rgod thog pa'i 'od zer las sprul pa'i bu/ dbal bon stag la me 'bar gyi thugs sprul/ dbra khyung sngags 'chang dbal 'bar stag slag can bdag la sa pho sprel lo hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gsum gyi nangs par/ nyi ma shar ba'i rtse la gdos bcas snang yol gyis ma bsgrib par/ gtso 'khor kun sprul pa dang bcas pa/ nam mkha'i dbyings nas mngon sum du zhal bstan nas/ spyi spungs gab pa gsang chen gyi rgyud rnams yongs su rdzogs par snyan du brgyud nas/ bstan pa bon gyi ma dang sring mor zhal gyis bzhes nas/ gsang ba'i rag ta mngon sum du byin cing / dam tshig gi bsre ba mdzad pa dang / dus rgyun du mi 'bral bar ma sring brtse gdung bzhin du mchod pa'i skong la gshegs shing grogs mdzad pa sogs kyi rdzu 'phrul mang du bstan cing / bka' yi srung ma gnyan po ru g.yar dam gnas so/ dmar gyi tshogs la spyan 'dren pa'i dus su/ srid pa'i rgyal mo mngon sum gyis rdzu 'phrul mdzad cing*/ bshams pa'i dam rdzas dngos su bzhes nas/ gdung dbyangs glu dang chas te/ lung bstan pa'am bstan pa'i srung ma ru mdzad cing g.yar dam gcig pa'i tshig 'di ltar du gsungs/ kye kye/ dbal chen sngags 'chang sprul pa'i sras/ nga ni srid pa'i rgyal mo ste/ dbyings kyi bde 'gro chen mo yin/ 'das pa'i dbyings su thabs rol pa/ rdzu 'phrul sprul pa'i 'od zer can/ lha rgod mkha' 'gying kha yi sku/ ma mchog srid rgyal yum gyi dbyings/ mkha' dang dbyings la yongs dog med/ phyi dang nang du phye ba med/ g.yas dang g.yon du 'gyur ba med/ thabs dang shes rab 'bral ba med/ mkha' gsal chu zla gzha' tshon 'od/ gzha' 'od chu la shar ba de/ chu zla gnyis su snang ba med/ nam mkha' dag pa'i rang mdangs gsal/ skyon dang dri mas dben pa ste/ 'khrul pa'i the tshom phyi rol dor/ ma rig rmongs pa gnyis 'dzin blo/ khyud mo can gyi pha mthar bzod/ rig pa'i ye shes lde mig de/ rigs kyi bdag po'i lag tu longs/ rgyal bstan rin chen g.yung drung bon/ ye khyab mkha' mtha' ma rdzogs par/ bstan pa'i srung ma bdag gis byed/ ye nas gsal ba'i me long la/ gnyis 'dzin lta ba'i ma gos shig drung mu sad wer sad do mchog/ las kyi lha rgod mkha' 'gying kha/ dungs dungs 'bod pa'i mi gang de/ rgyun du bon nyid yum gyi klong / sbas pa'i gur du bdag rol nas/ blo phyir ltos pa'i sems mkhan de/ khyud mo 'khor ba'i mthar bor cig de skad gsung zhing bstan pa srung bar zhal 'ches mang du thob so (bo/)de ltar rgyal mo'i thugs kyi gzer bu/ gsang zhing gces pa'i man ngag shin tu brnag pa'i brnag pa/ bon gyi bstan pa srung ba'i/ dam can gnyan mo'i phrin las/ u ya sa ma ya//
